import msvcrt, os, tempfile, json

with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False) as tf:
    p = tf.name

try:
    with open(p, 'w+b') as f1:
        f1.write(b' ' + json.dumps({'pid': 1234, 'time': 5678}).encode())
        f1.flush()
        f1.seek(0)
        msvcrt.locking(f1.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_NBLCK, 1)
        
        # Now try to read from f2 starting at byte 1
        with open(p, 'rb') as f2:
            f2.seek(1)
            data = f2.read()
            print('Read under lock byte 1:', data)
            
        f1.seek(0)
        msvcrt.locking(f1.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_UNLCK, 1)
finally:
    os.unlink(p)
